hero.heading: Uncle's Deli
hero.arcBody: Hand-seasoned, slow-roasted rotisserie chicken. Find us in the heart of The English Market.

about.heading: Born in the heart of Cork.
about.pullQuote: No shortcuts. No timers. Just fire.
paragraphs: We started Uncle's with one simple idea: rotisserie chicken the way it should be — hand-seasoned, slow-roasted over an open flame, and served fresh every single day.

Tucked inside Cork's legendary English Market, we're proud to be part of Ireland's most iconic food destination. Every bird is sourced locally, every recipe is made with love, and every customer leaves with a full belly and a smile.
Whether you're grabbing a quick lunch or feeding the whole crew, Uncle's has you covered. No fuss. Just fire.
